verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Orama's search/vector/AI features and cloud/MCP capabilities but contains no explicit statement, policy, or documentation about preventing user data from being used to train AI models (e.g., no data-usage/training opt-out policy, no statement about third-party model providers not retaining data for training). On-premise deployment (orama-docs-8) hints at data control but does not address AI-training usage specifically.
